description: Data type 'dnsName' is a Domain Name System (DNS) host name, with an optional port or port range. A wildcard "*" may be used as the left-most part of the host name. Any text can be read as a dnsName; it is not checked. Two dnsName values are equal when they are the same ignoring case, as DNS names are. It has no ordering. In a script, write one as a typed literal: "example.com"dnsName or "example.com"dns.
